questions.stem: Which of the following is a definition of a quadrilateral?
choices: A figure with four straight sides
A figure with four curved sides
A figure with three straight sides
A figure with five straight sides
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'A figure with four straight sides' because a quadrilateral is defined as a polygon with four straight sides. The other options are incorrect because they describe figures with curved sides or a different number of sides, which do not meet the criteria for a quadrilateral.

questions.stem: Which property of parallelograms is used to tile the plane using any given triangle?
choices: The sum of angles of a quadrilateral is 360°
The diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other
Opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal and parallel
The adjacent angles of a parallelogram are supplementary
questions.solution: The property that opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal and parallel is used to tile the plane using any given triangle. This is because a triangle can be duplicated and arranged to form a parallelogram, which can then be repeated to cover the plane. The other options are true properties of parallelograms but are not directly used for tiling.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a property of a parallelogram?
choices: Opposite sides are equal and parallel
questions.solution: A parallelogram is defined by having opposite sides that are both equal and parallel, which is the third option. The first option is incorrect because only opposite sides are equal, not all sides. The second option is incorrect because angles can vary, though opposite angles are equal. The fourth option is incorrect because diagonals bisect each other but are not necessarily perpendicular.

questions.stem: In the tiling of the plane using a 4-gon, what is the significance of the sum of the internal angles of the 4-gon?
questions.solution: The sum of the internal angles of any quadrilateral is always 360°, which is essential for tiling the plane without gaps or overlaps. This property ensures that the 4-gon can be arranged in a way that fills the plane completely. The other options do not satisfy this condition.

questions.stem: A quadrilateral is formed by four points A, B, C, D, and it is given that AB + CD = AD + BC. What type of quadrilateral is this?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'Rhombus'. If AB + CD = AD + BC, this implies that the quadrilateral is tangential, meaning it has an incircle that touches all four sides. A rhombus is a quadrilateral with all sides equal, and it is tangential. A square and rectangle are also tangential, but they have specific angle and side length constraints, which are not necessarily implied here. A trapezium is not necessarily tangential.

hi.stem: एक चतुर्भुज चार बिंदुओं A, B, C, D द्वारा बनाया जाता है, और यह दिया गया है कि AB + CD = AD + BC। यह किस प्रकार का चतुर्भुज है?
hi.solution: सही उत्तर 'समचतुर्भुज' है। यदि AB + CD = AD + BC, तो इसका अर्थ है कि चतुर्भुज स्पर्शीय है, अर्थात इसकी चारों भुजाओं को स्पर्श करने वाला एक अंतःवृत्त है। समचतुर्भुज एक चतुर्भुज है जिसकी सभी भुजाएं समान होती हैं, और यह स्पर्शीय होता है। एक वर्ग और आयत भी स्पर्शीय होते हैं, लेकिन उनके विशिष्ट कोण और भुजा लंबाई की आवश्यकता होती है, जो यहां आवश्यक रूप से निहित नहीं है। एक समलंब चतुर्भुज आवश्यक रूप से स्पर्शीय नहीं होता है।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses standard Hindi mathematical terminology.

mr.stem: चौकोन चार बिंदू A, B, C, D द्वारे तयार केला जातो आणि दिले आहे की AB + CD = AD + BC. हा चौकोन कोणत्या प्रकारचा असेल?
mr.solution: हे बरोबर उत्तर 'हिरोमस' आहे. जर AB + CD = AD + BC, तर हे दर्शवते की चौकोन स्पर्श चौकोन आहे, ज्याला सर्व चार बाजूंना स्पर्श करणारा एक वर्तुळ असते. एक हिरोमस हा चौकोन आहे ज्याच्या सर्व बाजू बरोबर असतात आणि तो स्पर्श चौकोन असतो. चौरस आणि आयत देखील स्पर्श चौकोन असतात, परंतु त्यांच्याकडे विशिष्ट कोन आणि बाजूंच्या लांबीच्या अटी असतात, ज्या येथे आवश्यकतेनुसार निश्चित केल्या जात नाहीत. समलंब चौकोन स्पर्श चौकोन नसतो.
mr.critique: The Marathi translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate technical terms (e.g., 'समलंब चौकोन' for trapezium, 'हिरोमस' for rhombus). The solution correctly identifies the rhombus as the answer and explains why other options are incorrect.

questions.stem: If the diagonals of a quadrilateral bisect each other, then it is a parallelogram. What is the reason for this?
choices: Because the opposite sides are equal and parallel
Because the opposite angles are equal and supplementary
Because the diagonals intersect at right angles
questions.solution: If the diagonals of a quadrilateral bisect each other, then the opposite sides are equal and parallel, which is the definition of a parallelogram. The other options are not the primary reason for this conclusion.
